summary: Iteration 89 — Phase-3 bundles (CA / Owner / Franchisor) + 3 master dashboards + deprecation banner. Backend: 9/9 HTTP integration tests pass + 1 xfailed security observation (test_bundles_endpoints.py) and 7/7 bundle_generator unit tests still pass. Frontend live-verified: /dashboard/ca, /dashboard/franchisor, /dashboard/franchise-owner all render with the 7 required data-testids; sidebar Accounts group shows ★ CA Dashboard + ★ Franchisor Dashboard; /owner-reports deprecation banner present and links to CA/Franchisor Dashboards. NOTE: fixed a P0 backend defect — bundles route was querying centers by the non-existent field `center_code` so every (center, period) returned 404; corrected to `code` to match the rest of the codebase.

minor.issue: verify_token_sync return value is ignored — `if _verify_token: _verify_token(token)` does not check the None return, so an unrecognised token still produces a valid ZIP download. Missing-token is correctly 4xx (FastAPI 422) so the review item is met, but invalid/expired tokens leak data. Recommend: `data = _verify_token(token); if not data: raise HTTPException(401, 'Invalid or expired token')`.

action_items: (Optional, security) Enforce verify_token_sync return in routes/bundles.py — raise HTTPException(401) when it returns None. Today, an invalid token still downloads the bundle (verified live with token='obviously-bad-token').
(Carry-forward) routes/center_accounts.py 3376 lines and routes/franchises.py 1203 lines still exceed 700-line guideline.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/bundles.py:46 — FIXED in this iteration. Was `db.centers.find_one({'center_code': center.upper()})` but the entire centers collection stores the code under field `code` (10 docs verified). All other routes (owner_reports, daily_text, masters, center_accounts, center_health) use `code`. Without this fix, every legit request returned 404 'Center not found' so no bundle was actually downloadable in production.

routes/bundles.py:136-138, 154-156, 172-174 — `if _verify_token: _verify_token(token)` is a no-op auth check. verify_token_sync returns None for bad/expired tokens but the route discards the return value. The download is gated only by the JWT being a valid 32-byte URL-safe string shape, not by lookup. Pre-existing minor security defect.

utils/bundle_generator.py — clean module: every figure flows from `engine = compute_franchise_payout(...)` which is the single source of truth (verified by test_pdf_text_contains_engine_figures + the new test_ca_pdf_contains_engine_figures_and_entity HTTP test). Manifest audit trail includes Selected Base / Owner Share / Company Entity + 'financial_engine.py' reference — all 3 audit-trail assertions pass for ca / owner / franchisor.

CADashboard.jsx + FranchisorDashboard.jsx + FranchiseOwnerDashboard.jsx — all data-testids placed correctly (ca-dashboard, ca-center-select, ca-period-input, download-ca-bundle, franchisor-dashboard, download-franchisor-bundle, fo-download-bundle-btn). Dashboard.jsx:678-680 wires the 3 routes.

OwnerReports.jsx:305-318 — deprecation banner uses amber-themed alert with anchor links to /dashboard/ca and /dashboard/franchisor. Properly tagged with data-testid='owner-reports-deprecation-banner'.

rca_of_the_issue: RCA — bundles 404 for all requests: routes/bundles.py was written against an assumed schema (`center_code` field) but the live `centers` collection stores the code under `code` (consistent with 8 other routes I sampled). Repro: GET /api/bundles/ca?token=<valid>&center=PB-MGT&period=2026-05 returned 404 'Center PB-MGT not found' before the fix; returns 200 application/zip after the fix. Mitigation: 1-line change at routes/bundles.py:46 — `{'center_code': center.upper()}` → `{'code': center.upper()}`. No tests previously caught this because test_bundle_generator.py only exercises the in-process build_*_pdf / build_bundle_zip helpers with a hand-built ctx dict, never the HTTP route. The new test_bundles_endpoints.py closes that gap.
